# G82 — Every low-dimensional manifold in the wiki is measured, none is generated

**Status:** `PARTIAL`  
**Kind:** `part`  
**Registry:** [[wiki/architectural-gaps.md]]  
**Closes when:** A manifold is generated by a stated construction — low-rank connectivity, spectral gap, symmetry breaking or a wiring-rule Laplacian — and the coefficients on that basis are produced by the model rather than fitted after the fact.

## Why it blocks the target

Population geometry is the wiki's standard level of description — manifolds, subspaces, order parameters — and in every case the manifold is recovered *after the fact* by a dimensionality-reduction algorithm run on activity. A structured flow on a manifold requires a generator: a spectral gap at an instability, a low-rank coupling matrix, or a broken symmetry. Without one, a low-dimensional projection is compatible with a structured flow and does not evidence one, so claims that the manifold *does* computation (rather than displaying it) are unsupported — and no architecture here can be built to have a manifold of a specified shape

## Best current answer

Three named candidates, none arbitrated and none implemented: **low-rank connectivity** (rank `r` confines the dynamics to `r` dimensions by construction), **averaging/decorrelation** (the spectral gap of the Fokker–Planck operator, [[wiki/concepts/mean-field-reduction.md]] rung 3), and **symmetry breaking in the reduced space** (Jirsa & Sheheitli — an equivariant system's reduced flow is degenerate; heterogeneous long-range edges break the equivariance). These fix the manifold in the weights, in the statistics, and in the flow respectively, so they are not variants of one story. A fourth, added by Vohryzek et al. 2024: **the anatomical Laplacian spectrum** — take the graph itself as the generator and its low eigenvectors as the manifold's axes, which requires no activity, no instability and no fitting, and is the only one of the four that hands a builder explicit coordinates

## From

Hashemi et al. 2025; [[wiki/concepts/structured-flows-on-manifolds.md]]; Vohryzek et al. 2024, [[wiki/concepts/anatomical-harmonic-modes.md]]

## Status

`PARTIAL` — a fourth candidate is now instantiated and it is the only one that produces a *usable basis*: the eigenvectors of a Laplacian built from the wiring rule (exponential distance decay + its rare >3 SD long-range violations), computed in closed form before the system runs, with ~20 of 200 modes carrying the bulk of both spontaneous and 47 task-evoked activity. What it does not close: the coefficients `a_k(t)` get no dynamics, so the basis is generated and the *flow on it* still is not
